'Doha, doha. '  
Ten years ago, the last request I repeated while holding Doha, who was stopping.  
Da-kyung never dreamed that it would cause a situation like today.  
Doha narrowed the distance and grabbed Dakyung's chin.

“I don’t want to say anything, so open your mouth.“

Iron Armoured and Armoured. At the sound of the buckle loosening, Da-kyung nervously wore a lip.

"You're supposed to be..." ... Was he like this?  
“I wasn’t originally like this. How could he even be nicknamed Yoon Da-kyung's dog?"

The faintly curved corners of their eyes sank coldly.  
“But, it became like this because I was discarded after eating.“  
“…….”  
“So stop talking about the boring things and open your mouth, Dakyung.“

The thumb, which was wandering along Da-kyung's lip line, unexpectedly wandered through the gap.

“How much will you kill your mouth in 10 years? I'm curious about the time of the mountain, sir."

*

Yoon Da-kyung, who suddenly disappeared from Hagok on the night of her 20s.  
And Yoon Da-kyung's dog, Kwon Do-ha, who was a man who found her and went through.

Nineteen, the story of two people who are terribly intertwined with each other's lives.
